upshot.description:
What the call came to in one line, for the step that shows it
(ADR-0095 §9). The model never reads it.

ToolOutput.description:
What a tool returned: the parts the model sees, plus what a person sees
instead when the tool has something better than the text (ADR-0013 §2).

path.description:
Where the same bytes are on this machine, when they are anywhere: a
picture read off a disk, or one a surface wrote before handing it on
(ADR-0052). A location, not a second copy — absent from the wire and
the journal when there is none, so a picture without one is the
bytes it always was.

Image.description:
A picture handed to the model, already the shape the journal keeps and a
provider's request encodes: one struct, so a surface that reads a picture
off disk, a wire client that already holds the bytes, and a tool result
that returns one all produce the same thing.

children.description: Strings and nested `Text` nodes, drawn in order.

color.description: A colour name or `#rrggbb`; the surface may adjust it to its theme.

inverse.description: Swap the foreground and background colours.

wrap.description: `wrap` breaks long lines at the width; `truncate` cuts them.

oneOf.description: A run of text: strings and nested `Text` nodes, which keep their own style.
Markdown text the surface renders.

language.description: The language name for highlighting, such as `rust`.

oneOf.description: A block of source code.
A diff drawn with added and removed lines marked.
A bulleted list of lines.

rows.description: One array of cells per row, in column order.

oneOf.description: A table of strings.
Aligned label and value pairs.

total.description: The whole; without it the surface shows a count.

oneOf.description: A progress bar, or a count when there is no total.

tone.description: `neutral`, `good`, `bad` or `attention`; the surface picks the colour.

oneOf.description: A short label coloured by its tone.
An indented tree of labelled nodes.

question.description:
A question owner's editing state, on the root of a drawn question;
the choices' labels and the answer stay the host's.

hints.description: The focused site declares chrome separately from its body.

onKey.description: A handler for a key pressed while this box's pane has focus; return `{handled: false}` to give the key back.

flexGrow.description: How much of the spare room this box takes; `0` takes none.

flexWrap.description: `wrap` lets children flow onto another line.

margin.description: Cells outside the box on every side.

marginX.description: Cells outside the box on the left and right.

marginY.description: Rows outside the box above and below.

padding.description: Cells inside the box on every side.

paddingX.description: Cells inside the box on the left and right.

paddingY.description: Rows inside the box above and below.

borderStyle.description: Any value but `none` draws a border.

display.description: `none` hides the box and its controls.

oneOf.description: A flex container: lays its children out in a row or a column.
One view under a title.
A row of buttons that each run a named action.

children.description: The button's text, when `label` is not given.

hotkey.description: One letter: pressed with Alt in a band, or alone in a focused pane, it presses the button.

variant.description: `primary` draws it bold, `danger` in the alarm colour.

onPress.description: The handler run when the button is pressed: a mod passes a function.

oneOf.description: A pressable control; a mod's `onPress` runs when it is pressed.

placeholder.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

onInput.description: The handler run as the text changes: a mod passes a function.

onSubmit.description: The handler run when the person presses Enter: a mod passes a function.

oneOf.description: A one-line text field.

onSelect.description: The handler run with the chosen value: a mod passes a function.

oneOf.description: A choice among options.

label.description: The text shown; the URL when absent.

oneOf.description: A link the person can open.

alt.description: Text shown where the image cannot be.

oneOf.description: A picture; surfaces that cannot draw it show `alt`.
A grid of character cells, drawn by terminals only.

alt.description: Text shown where the drawing cannot be.

oneOf.description: An SVG drawing, for surfaces that draw vectors; others show `alt`.

component.description: The component bingo draws, such as `ToolUse`.

props.description: That component's props, as its `ui.render` event carried them.

oneOf.description: bingo's own drawing of a component, placed inside a mod's view.

fold.description: The plain text drawn where the element is unknown.

oneOf.description: An element bingo has no name for; surfaces that do not know it show `fold`.

TextChild.description: A text child preserves the style of its nested Text node.

oneOf.description: Wants a person: a surface makes it move.

Tone.description: The one styling hook a plugin has; the surface owns the colour.

QuestionFocus.description: A question owner's editing projection; sealed labels remain the host's.

Action.description: A typed action a client asks for (GUI buttons, hosts); the kernel dispatches it to a command.

key.description: A single-key hint; the surface may use another key.

ActionItem.description: A button: the surface fires `Input::Action` with `action` (ADR-0008 §1).

oneOf.description: Lines a change added and removed; counts add up across a turn.
A few words, and whether they are good or bad news.

Upshot.description: A call's result in one line: `+1 −1`, `3 passed`, `exit 1`.

session.description: The session this concerns; `$` methods default it to the current one.

SessionId.description: One persisted context: one journal, one actor.

systemExtra.description:
What the session was opened with and a resume must give it back:
the prompt appended to the kernel's own, and the tool set it is held to.

busy.description:
A turn is running. A summary travels without the turn it describes —
a host listing carries no `SessionState` — so the kernel stamps this
on every summary it publishes and nothing else writes it. A client
that holds the state derives the same fact with `SessionState::busy`.

asking.description: An interaction is open; stamped only by the session actor.

messages.description:
How many messages have been said in this session, by
[`Event::completes_a_message`]. `None` is "never counted" — a summary
written before the field existed — and must be shown as nothing rather
than as a `0` it does not mean.

ParentLink.description:
Where a child hangs in the tree: its parent, and the tool call that
spawned it when one did (ADR-0011 §3).

ItemId.description: One unit in the transcript order.

oneOf.description: A model answers: every prose input opens a turn.
Nothing answers: every input is recorded, and the journal is the point.

Driver.description: What a session does with what it is told (ADR-0011 §1).

ChoiceScope.description: Whether the chosen model applies only here or is the default for new sessions.

Effort.description: Reasoning effort, in the vocabulary providers converge on.

Usage.description:
Token counts as the provider reports them, the three input counts kept
apart: `input_tokens` is what the model read fresh, the cache counts are
what it read from or wrote to a cached prefix. The whole input side is
`input_total()`.

TurnId.description: One run of the turn loop, closed exactly once.

truncated.description: Whether the body was cut at the host's limit.

notice.description: A note from the host about the fetch, if any.

argv.description: The program and its arguments; no shell is involved.

cwd.description: Working directory; the session's cwd unless given.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the process after this many milliseconds.

code.description: The exit code, or `null` when killed by a signal.

path.description: Relative to the session's cwd, or absolute under a granted root.
Relative to the session's cwd, or absolute under a granted root.
Relative to the session's cwd, or absolute under a granted root.

file.description: Whether it is a regular file.

name.description: One file or directory name, without a separator.

maxBytes.description:
Optional byte budget for the whole JSON-RPC response; absent preserves
`limit == 0` meaning all, not an implicit bounded page.

generation.description: Reject a stale page after a rewind/compaction rather than mixing views.

oversized.description:
This item alone cannot fit the requested page. Fetch it explicitly in
parts before following `next`, which excludes that item.

intent.description: The client intent that produced this item, when one did (user items).

IntentId.description: A client-minted write id; the outcome arrives as `IntentAck`.

anyOf.description:
A shell line a person ran themselves (`!<command>`, ADR-0008 §5): no
turn was spent on it and no model asked for it. `exit` is the code the
command came to; `None` says it never reached one — its timeout or an
interrupt ended it, and `output` carries the line that says which.
A long-running non-turn operation (login, reconnect, team start).
A payload this build cannot read, carried without interpretation.

renderSurface.description: Drawing family of the caller, independent of its attribution identifier.

Origin.description: Who submitted the input, as every surface records it.

Voice.description: How a producer intends an utterance to be drawn.

InteractionId.description: A pending question or permission, answered once by id.

checksum.description: FNV-1a 64 of the exact serialized Item UTF-8, lowercase hex.

OversizedItem.description:
The actor's factual observation; only the RPC server can add a
connection-scoped availability token after pinning an immutable Item.

session.description: Tokens used by the whole session.

context.description: The current context window reading, once known.

lastTurn.description: Tokens used by the last turn.

parts.description: Approximate local request composition, independent of server anchoring.

used.description: Tokens the next request would carry, anchored on the server's last count.

window.description:
The input side of the model's window: what is left once the output
budget is reserved (ADR-0006).

trigger.description:
`used` at which the older turns are summarised, equal to `window`
where the kernel draws no line because the endpoint holds the context
and cuts it itself (ADR-0055 §2).

ContextUsage.description:
The one ruler for context: used tokens, the model window, and the point at
which compaction triggers.

delivery.description: Whether it wakes the receiver or waits for its next turn.

images.description:
The pictures the ask carries, in the order they reach the journal
(ADR-0040): exactly as they will be journaled, because a surface
resolves a picture and the kernel does no file I/O for input.

delivery.description:
Whether a running turn may be steered with it (ADR-0008 §2,
amended M68). `Wake` is the line every client has always sent, so
it is the default and nothing is written for it.

origin.description:
The door it came through. Absent, or a door that is not a person
surface, and the action is not the person's own: it fails closed.

Input.description:
The one submission entry. The kernel parses `/`, `!` and `@` in text and
decides turn, queue, steer or deliver; a client never chooses.

oneOf.description: An idle target opens a turn on it; a busy one absorbs it at the next barrier.
It waits in the queue for whatever opens the next turn.

Delivery.description:
How a line reaches a session's queue: a peer's message (ADR-0010 §1) and
a person's own line are the same question, so they are the same word.

kind.description: What kind of question it is.

answers.description: The answers the person may give.

input.description: The call after hooks and interceptors, before this decision.

sessionScope.description: The rule `AllowSession` would install, when one would silence the prompt.

oneOf.description:
One question on its own. It holds [`Question`] flattened, so the frame
it makes is the one it always was.

title.description:
What the whole set is about, in the asker's own words: an MCP
server's elicitation says which server is asking. A set the model
opened has nothing to add to its own questions and names none.

oneOf.description:
A set of questions put at once and answered together (M53). Every
question is the same [`Question`] a lone one is.

role.description:
What picking it would mean to a session that answers for the person
(ADR-0039 §2). Unmarked options are a person's alone.

preview.description:
A few lines of monospace shown beside the option while the cursor is
on it — the layout or the snippet picking it would mean (M53).

oneOf.description: "Let it happen."
The refusal a question falls to when nobody answers it.

AnswerRole.description:
The two options a session may answer a question with when nobody is asked
(ADR-0039 §2). The asker names them in its own words; the kernel reads
which is which and never the words.

header.description: A short tag a surface may show before the question (`Auth method`).

Question.description:
One question put to a person: what is asked, what may be picked, and
whether words of one's own or more than one option count. A lone question
and one of a form are the same thing (M53).

oneOf.description:
The options ticked and, beside them, the words a person typed of their
own (M59): a question may be answered both ways at once, and dropping
either half loses what they said. An old frame carries no `other` and
reads as the ticks alone. Words with nothing ticked are
[`Answer::Text`], which is what a question answered in words alone has
always been.

A form's answers, one per question in the order they were asked; a
question nobody answered is [`Answer::Cancel`] in its place (M53).

input.description: What to submit, as a person would type it.

queue.description: Inputs waiting for the next turn.

ToolCall.description: A call the model asked for, before or after the gate.

meta.description:
What a catalogue may show beside the tool (an MCP tool's `server`);
never sent to a model.

ToolSpec.description: A tool as the model sees it.

name.description: The command's name, without the slash.

opens.description:
Run bare, it opens the place where its argument is chosen, so a
palette runs it rather than listing `args`; `args` stays for every
surface that completes it.

hint.description: A one-line description for the command menu; argument syntax belongs in `args`.

instant.description: May run while a turn is busy (read-only commands).

KeyBinding.description:
A chord a command declares for itself. A bare chord runs the command
alone; one with `args` submits the command with them, so a shortcut for
`/model next` is a binding on `model` and not a second catalogue entry.

oneOf.description: An argument followed by optional flags, completed from the same spec.
Completed from a catalog kind the command validates against.

alone.description: Words among `values` that end the argument; `then` does not apply.

person.description:
Words among `values` only the person may run: they raise trust or
let repository code run, so no link rewrites a line that starts
with one and no view bingo did not draw may send one.

oneOf.description:
One of the words the command lists itself, in the order it offers
them. A surface completes from the list; the kernel carries it.

`then` says what the word after one of `values` is — the name
`/plugins enable` takes, the server `/mcp reconnect` takes — and is
absent for a command whose argument ends at the first word, so every
spec written before it reads the same (ADR-0008 §6a).

ConfigView.description: Configuration as a client sees it: the kernel's keys and each plugin's claimed slice.

session.description:
Whose turn this is. A stateless provider ignores it; one that keeps a
conversation of its own per session — an ACP adapter holding one agent
session per bingo session (ADR-0035 §3), a stateful wire like the
Responses API — has no other way to know which conversation it is
answering. `None` is a request built by hand or a side question, which
belongs to no session.

SystemBlock.description: One cacheable segment of the system prompt.

oneOf.description: The complete call. `input` is the raw JSON text; the loop parses it once.

What the endpoint says it is holding for this session: its own count,
against its own window (ADR-0055 §2). Sent as often as it likes; the
last one of a round is what that round reports.

A cut the endpoint made in the context it holds (ADR-0055 §3). The
journal lost nothing by it: it is a row, not a rewrite.

ModelEvent.description: Provider stream events. Never published; the accumulator folds them into items.

labels.description: The labels the model chooses from.

mcp.call.description: Call `tool` on MCP `server` with `args`, through the MCP service.

mcp.connect.description: Connect MCP `server`, through the MCP service.

agent.spawn.description: Start a sub-agent with `{args: {prompt, agent?}}`, through the agent service; answers with its result.

agent.list.description: The sub-agents of a session, through the agent service.

agent.register.description: Register an agent `{definition}`, through the agent service.

http.fetch.description: Fetch a URL through the host; the body is text and may be `truncated`.

env.get.description: Read a variable from the mod's environment overlay, or `null`.

env.set.description: Set a variable in the mod's environment overlay; processes it starts see it.

process.run.description: Run `argv` to completion and answer with its exit code and output.

process.spawn.description: Start `argv` in the background; the author call answers with a handle to read, write or kill.

process.read.description: Wait for a spawned process to exit and read all its output; a process is read once.

process.write.description: Write `body` to a spawned process's stdin; `null` closes it.

fs.read.description: Read a file under a granted root, as UTF-8 text or base64.

fs.write.description: Write a file under a granted root, replacing it.

fs.list.description: List the entries of a directory under a granted root, up to `limit`.

fs.exists.description: Whether a path exists under a granted root.

fs.stat.description: Size and kind of a path under a granted root.

fs.ancestors.description: Each directory from the session's cwd up to the project root that holds `name`, nearest first.

session.messages.description: A page of the session's history.

session.model.description: The model the session is using, or `null`.

session.turns.description: The ids of the session's turns, oldest first.

session.surfaces.description: The clients attached to the session.

session.usage.description: Token usage: the whole session, the last turn, and `context`, the current context window reading.

session.version.description: The bingo version running the mod.

session.compact.description: Ask the session to compact its history; runs `session.compact`.

session.send.description: Send input to another session; runs `session.send`.

session.append.description: Append a record this plugin owns to the session's history; runs `session.append`.

session.authorize.description: Ask the person a question with the given answer kinds and wait for the answer.

turn.abort.description: End the session's running turn, as `esc` does.

prompt.submit.description: Submit input to the session as if typed; runs `prompt.submit`.

prompt.read.description: The session's queued inputs and the last submitted line.

tool.list.description: Every tool the session offers the model.

tool.call.description: Call a tool as the model would; runs `tool.check` and `tool.call`, so permission still applies.

tool.register.description: Register a tool the model can call; the author call takes the spec and a handler.

command.list.description: Every slash command the session offers.

command.run.description: Run a slash command by name; runs `command.run`.

command.register.description: Register a slash command; the author call takes the spec and an optional handler.

config.list.description: Every setting as the session sees it.

config.read.description: Read one setting by its dotted key.

model.complete.description: Ask the host's model for a completion; runs `model.complete`.

model.classify.description: Ask the model to pick one of `labels` for `text`, or `null`.

model.fork.description: Ask the model a one-off `prompt` with the session's context, outside the history.

state.get.description: Read this plugin's value for `key` in the current session, with its version, or `null`.

state.set.description: Write this plugin's value for `key` in the current session; `ifVersion` refuses a stale write.

store.get.description: Read this plugin's global value for `key`, shared across sessions, or `null`.

store.set.description: Write this plugin's global value for `key`; `ifVersion` refuses a stale write.

store.delete.description: Delete this plugin's global value for `key`; answers whether it existed.

store.keys.description: Every key this plugin has in the global store.

clock.now.description: The host's time in milliseconds since the epoch; tests can set it.

clock.sleep.description: Wait `ms` milliseconds on the host clock.

clock.after.description: Run a callback once after `ms` milliseconds; answers its timer id.

clock.every.description: Run a callback every `ms` milliseconds; answers its timer id.
